title.purpose: Name of the wishlist screen and its sidebar entry.
title.where: Sidebar, and the heading of the Wishlists screen.

off.message.purpose: Says the wishlist feature is off, so the screen has nothing to show.
off.message.where: Wishlist screen, when the feature is off.

off.settings.purpose: Link from the turned-off wishlist screen to Settings, where the feature is turned on.
off.settings.where: Wishlist screen, when the feature is off.

feature.panel.purpose: Heading of the Settings panel that holds switches for optional features.

feature.label.purpose: Label of the Settings switch that turns the wishlist feature on or off.

feature.helpOff.purpose: Help under the Wishlists switch while it is off.

feature.helpOn.purpose: Help under the Wishlists switch while it is on.

feature.error.purpose: Says the Wishlists switch could not be saved.

import.title.purpose: Heading of the panel where a wishlist is made from a pasted list or a CSV file.

import.name.purpose: Label of the field for the new wishlist's name.

import.paste.purpose: Label of the box where a tracklist is pasted.

import.makeFromPaste.purpose: Button that makes a wishlist from the pasted text.

import.chooseCsv.purpose: Button that picks a CSV file (for example from Exportify) and makes a wishlist from it.

import.csvFilter.purpose: Name of the file type in the file picker.

import.csvNameHint.purpose: Explains how the wishlist from a CSV file is named.

import.added_one.purpose: Says how many tracks the new wishlist took (one).

import.added_other.purpose: Says how many tracks the new wishlist took (other numbers).

import.skippedTitle_one.purpose: Heading over the lines an import could not take (one).

import.skippedTitle_other.purpose: Heading over the lines an import could not take (other numbers).

import.skippedLine.purpose: One line or row an import could not take, with where it was and why.

skip.noSeparator.purpose: Why a pasted line was not taken.

skip.missingArtist.purpose: Why a line or row was not taken.

skip.missingTitle.purpose: Why a line or row was not taken.

skip.unreadable.purpose: Why a CSV row was not taken.

lists.label.purpose: Label of the list of wishlists.

lists.summary_one.purpose: Counts under a wishlist's name when it has one track.

lists.summary_other.purpose: Counts under a wishlist's name when it has other numbers of tracks.

lists.delete.purpose: Button that deletes the chosen wishlist (Undo takes it back).

items.label.purpose: Label of the list of a wishlist's tracks.

items.none.purpose: Says the chosen wishlist is empty.

items.choose.purpose: Prompt shown before a wishlist is chosen.

kind.owned.purpose: Result of a wishlist track you have.

kind.ownedOtherCut.purpose: Result of a wishlist track you have as another cut; it counts as owned.

kind.rework.purpose: Result of a wishlist track you only have a rework of; it is not owned.

kind.missing.purpose: Result of a wishlist track you don't have.

reason.ownedLibrary.purpose: Why a track counts as owned: it is in the Library.
reason.ownedLibrary.where: Wishlist screen, beside a track's result.

reason.ownedAllMusic.purpose: Why a track counts as owned: it is in All music only.
reason.ownedAllMusic.where: Wishlist screen, beside a track's result.

reason.ownedIsrcLibrary.purpose: Why a track counts as owned: the ISRC matches a Library track.
reason.ownedIsrcLibrary.where: Wishlist screen, beside a track's result.

reason.ownedIsrcAllMusic.purpose: Why a track counts as owned: the ISRC matches a track in All music only.
reason.ownedIsrcAllMusic.where: Wishlist screen, beside a track's result.

reason.otherCutLibrary.purpose: Why a track counts as owned: another cut is in the Library.
reason.otherCutLibrary.where: Wishlist screen, beside a track's result.

reason.otherCutAllMusic.purpose: Why a track counts as owned: another cut is in All music only.
reason.otherCutAllMusic.where: Wishlist screen, beside a track's result.

reason.rework.purpose: Why a track is a hint and not owned: only a rework is there.
reason.rework.where: Wishlist screen, beside a track's result.

reason.missing.where: Wishlist screen, beside a track's result.

item.bought.purpose: Label of the checkbox that marks a wishlist track as bought.

item.notes.purpose: Label of the box for a note on a wishlist track.

item.remove.purpose: Button that removes a track from its wishlist (Undo takes it back).

links.title.purpose: Heading over the search links for a track.

links.copy.purpose: Button that copies a store's search address; the app never opens it.
links.copy.where: Wishlist screen, on a track, store links.

links.copied.where: Wishlist screen, on a track, store links.

links.failed.purpose: Says the address could not be copied.
links.failed.where: Wishlist screen, on a track, store links.

store.beatport.purpose: Name of a store the search link is for.

store.bandcamp.purpose: Name of a store the search link is for.

store.traxsource.purpose: Name of a store the search link is for.

store.juno.purpose: Name of a store the search link is for.

refusal.nameEmpty.purpose: Says why a wishlist action was refused.
refusal.nameEmpty.where: Wishlist screen, under the import panel or the items.

refusal.nameTooLong.purpose: Says why a wishlist action was refused.
refusal.nameTooLong.where: Wishlist screen, under the import panel or the items.

refusal.notesTooLong.purpose: Says why a wishlist action was refused.
refusal.notesTooLong.where: Wishlist screen, under the import panel or the items.

refusal.noSuchWishlist.purpose: Says why a wishlist action was refused.
refusal.noSuchWishlist.where: Wishlist screen, under the import panel or the items.

refusal.noSuchItem.purpose: Says why a wishlist action was refused.
refusal.noSuchItem.where: Wishlist screen, under the import panel or the items.

refusal.notTurnedOn.purpose: Says why a wishlist action was refused.
refusal.notTurnedOn.where: Wishlist screen, under the import panel or the items.

refusal.tooManyItems.purpose: Says why a wishlist action was refused.
refusal.tooManyItems.where: Wishlist screen, under the import panel or the items.

refusal.fileUnreadable.purpose: Says why a wishlist action was refused.
refusal.fileUnreadable.where: Wishlist screen, under the import panel or the items.

refusal.fileTooBig.purpose: Says why a wishlist action was refused.
refusal.fileTooBig.where: Wishlist screen, under the import panel or the items.

refusal.textTooBig.purpose: Says why a wishlist action was refused.
refusal.textTooBig.where: Wishlist screen, under the import panel or the items.

refusal.noArtistColumn.purpose: Says why a wishlist action was refused.
refusal.noArtistColumn.where: Wishlist screen, under the import panel or the items.

refusal.noTitleColumn.purpose: Says why a wishlist action was refused.
refusal.noTitleColumn.where: Wishlist screen, under the import panel or the items.
